name: Bulletin Board Forum
summary: A web forum in tables: a list of boards in categories, topics with reply and view counts, and posts with a user column that shows an avatar, a rank, a post count and a signature.

philosophy.core_thesis: A forum is a club with rooms; each member carries a visible rank, a picture and a signature from post to post.
design_principles: Show the index as a table of boards in categories, with columns for topics, posts and the last post.
Put each post in a two-column table row: the user column of 150px to 180px at the left, the post at the right.
Show in the user column an avatar of 80px to 100px, a rank title, a row of rank pips, the join date and the post count.
Put a signature under each post after a short rule, with an image banner of at most 468px by 60px.
Use a header band with the forum logo, and a breadcrumb line: Index > Board > Topic.
Mark a pinned topic with a pin icon and a locked topic with a lock icon in the topic list.
anti_patterns: Endless scroll with no page numbers
Flat single-colour lists with no table rules

layout.grid_mechanics: Tables of fixed columns: a board list of 4 to 5 columns and a post table of 2 columns (user, post).
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 20% of the page stays empty; the cell padding is 4px to 6px.
layout.alignment_rules: Text aligns left in the cells; counts align centre; the page is a column of 90% width or 960px.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with a 0px to 4px radius; table cells with 1px rules; category bars with a gradient header.

font_pairings.note: Arimo is an open look-alike of Arial and Helvetica, the usual forum faces.
A later forum theme with a softer sans.

hierarchy_rules: Use sizes 11px, 12px and 13px for the tables and 18px for the topic title.
Set board names and usernames in bold link colour.
Set counts and dates in the small muted size.

color.palette_structure: A pale page with blue header bands and alternate row tints; 5 to 6 colours.
color.contrast_rules: Ink on white is 15:1; the forum blue on white is 8:1; white on the header blue is 6:1.
color.surface_treatment: Flat table cells and a vertical gradient on the category bars.
color.light_and_shadow: No shadow on cells; a 1px light top edge on buttons.

materiality.surface_simulation: A web table: ruled cells, tinted rows and small image buttons.
materiality.border_rules: 1px rules in pale blue grey (#C7D2DD) on all cells.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Small topic icons of 16px to 27px: a folder for a board, a pin, a lock and a 'new posts' dot.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Avatars of 80px to 100px, rank pip images and signature banners.

motion.transition_physics: Each click loads a new page; there is no animation except animated GIF avatars.
motion.hover_and_active: A link underlines on hover; a table row may tint on hover.

emotion.target_response: The reader feels at home in a club of regulars with ranks, in-jokes and long threads.

avoid_when: The product needs a modern mobile-first flow.
The brand needs a premium tone.

modifiers.how: Remove the user column and avatars; put an image at the start of each post.
Replace the tables with nested comments and a vote column.
Move the user column to a profile page with a top friends grid.

pack.why: Small filled icons match the folder, pin and lock icons of a topic list.

ground.why: A forum is ruled tables: thin lines between the rows.

tailwind.classes: rounded border border-[#C7D2DD] bg-[#EEF3F8] px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-[#105289] hover:bg-white
